S&P 500 vs Gold: 2000-2020 Performance Breakdown

Data Context for 2000-2020 Analysis
Historical data uses S&P 500 total return (including dividends) from NYU Stern tables and gold price returns. Total growth calculated from end-1999 to end-2020 index values: S&P 500 from $1,406.25 to $9,162.31 (price levels provided); gold from $282.10/oz (Jan 2000 start, NYU context) appreciating per annual returns. Volatility assessed via max drawdowns and standard deviation patterns from source charts. Crashes identified by peak-to-trough declines over 20% in S&P 500.

Total Growth and Volatility Comparison
S&P 500 delivered 551% total growth (from ~1,469 to 9,162 index points, compounded via annual returns averaging ~9.1%). Gold achieved ~306% growth (from $282/oz to ~1,150/oz end-2020, based on NYU cumulative and longtermtrends charts). S&P 500 exhibited higher volatility, with larger annual swings (e.g., -22% in 2002 vs gold's +25%) and deeper drawdowns during crashes; gold showed lower standard deviation and negative correlation periods for diversification.

Performance Metrics Table
| Metric                  | S&P 500 Total Return | Gold Price Return |
|-------------------------|----------------------|-------------------|
| Total Growth (2000-2020)| 551%                | 306%             |
| Avg Annual Return       | 9.1%                | 6.8%             |
| Highest Annual Gain     | 31.2% (2019)        | 25.6% (2002)     |
| Largest Annual Loss     | -22.0% (2002)       | -28.3% (2013)*   |
| Volatility (Std Dev)    | Higher (~15-18%)    | Lower (~12-15%)  |

*2013 loss outside peak crash but illustrates gold swings; S&P crashes drove superior volatility edge.

Major Market Crashes 2000-2020
- Dot-Com Bust (2000-2002): S&P 500 -49% peak-to-trough; gold +25% in 2002 as safe haven.
- Global Financial Crisis (2007-2009): S&P 500 -57%; gold dipped initially but rose 24% in 2009.
- COVID-19 Crash (Feb-Mar 2020): S&P 500 -34%; gold volatile but ended +24% yearly.

Key Periods Timeline
| Period          | S&P 500 Change | Gold Change | Notes                     |
|-----------------|----------------|-------------|---------------------------|
| 2000-2002      | -44%          | +58%       | Tech crash, gold rally    |
| 2007-2009      | -51%          | +26%       | GFC, gold hedge           |
| 2020           | +18%          | +24%       | Pandemic recovery         |

S&P 500 Comparison Chart Reference
https://www.longtermtrends.com/stocks-vs-gold-comparison/

Sources
https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/datafile/histretSP.html
https://www.longtermtrends.com/stocks-vs-gold-comparison/
https://curvo.eu/backtest/en/compare-indexes/gold-bullion-vs-sp-500
